mapper.sql: select id, def_key, name, category, content, schema_version, status, version, deploy_id, proc_def_id, remark, del_flag, create_id, create_by, create_time, update_id, update_by, update_time from t_flow_simple
mapper.select: where def_key = #{defKey} and del_flag = '0' order by update_time desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_flow_simple ( id, def_key, name, category, content, schema_version, status, version, deploy_id, proc_def_id, remark, del_flag, create_id, create_by, create_time, update_id, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{id}, #{defKey}, #{name}, #{category}, #{content}, #{schemaVersion}, #{status}, #{version}, #{deployId}, #{procDefId}, #{remark}, '0', #{createId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateId}, #{updateBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update t_flow_simple set del_flag = '1', update_id = #{updateId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
